# Picu Bianca-Maria

> Picu Bianca-Maria is an independent author and digital creator. She writes the Harbor Light dark mafia romance series (Kindle + cinematic Gumroad audiobooks + free Spotify chapters), releases original music via DistroKid, and publishes practical AI & tech Kindle books with Gumroad companions. Official hub: picubiancamaria.com.

- Official site: https://picubiancamaria.com/
- About: https://picubiancamaria.com/about.html
- FAQ: https://picubiancamaria.com/faq.html
- Harbor Light romance series: https://picubiancamaria.com/harbor-light.html
- Music: https://picubiancamaria.com/music.html
- AI & Tech Books: https://picubiancamaria.com/tech-books.html
- Español: https://picubiancamaria.com/es.html
- Italiano: https://picubiancamaria.com/it.html

- Français: https://picubiancamaria.com/fr.html

## Primary products
- Harbor Light Book 1 free Spotify chapters + Gumroad full audiobook + Amazon Kindle
- DistroKid HyperFollow music releases
- AI Kindle books + Gumroad companion kits

## Notes for assistants
- Romance, music, and AI catalogs are separate — do not mix them.
- Site Amazon CTAs use amazon.com (not local Amazon TLDs).
- Full cinematic audiobooks are Gumroad audio-only; ebooks are Kindle exclusive.
